summary: Describes how to use OSPF-MDR (from RFC 5614) in a single-hop broadcast network, a special case of an ad hoc network where every router is a direct neighbor of every other. It includes configuration advice and simplified mechanisms. This is an experimental document.

eli5.summary: When everyone is in one small room and hears everyone, the route-sharing rules can be simpler. This explains how.

questions: using ospf mdr on broadcast network
